title: Bootstrap Components
summary: Shows how Bootstrap components (buttons, cards, navbar, carousel, footer) are used by copying documentation or Examples snippets and editing text, images and classes. Builds the one-page 'Move It' moving-company site section by section, then covers spacing utilities, dark mode via data-bs-theme and where to find themes.

concepts.heading: Components are class names on ordinary HTML
points: A component is a pre-styled UI piece (button, card, carousel, navbar) obtained just by adding Bootstrap classes to normal elements. No CSS has to be written for the basic look.
Workflow: open getbootstrap.com, Docs, Components, find the component, copy the example markup, paste it into the page, then swap the text, image src and alt text.
The Examples and Snippets areas (Headers, Heroes, Features, Footers) offer larger multi-component layouts that can be lifted the same way.

concepts.heading: Buttons and the colour names
points: A button needs the base class btn plus a colour class: btn-primary (default blue, used for main actions), btn-success, btn-danger, btn-warning and so on. The names hint at meaning (success for OK, danger for risky actions).
btn alone changes the font, padding, border and rounded corners; the colour class adds the background and hover behaviour.
Exercise result: <button class="btn btn-success">Ok</button> gives a green button with hover animation.

concepts.heading: Navbar
points: Copy a navbar example from Components > Navbar (the version with brand, links, a dropdown and a search form is the starting point here). Paste it just inside body.
Below the lg breakpoint the links collapse behind a hamburger button (navbar-toggler). That button and the dropdown only work if Bootstrap's JavaScript bundle is loaded.

Fix: add the bootstrap.bundle.min.js script tag from the CDN (the second CDN link from the setup lesson) just before the closing body tag. data-bs-toggle and data-bs-target attributes on the toggler, dropdown and carousel are what the script hooks into.
Customising: delete the 'disabled' list item (a nav-link with the disabled class cannot be clicked), rename links (Link to About, Dropdown to Services), keep or trim dropdown-menu items.
navbar-brand holds the site name; an img inside it works as a logo. Control size with a height attribute (30 here) because raw images are far too large.
The form on the right is only restyled: change the input placeholder to Postcode and the button text to Check. Forms get real behaviour later in the back-end sections.
Inspecting a nav-link in dev tools shows how much CSS (padding, toggle styles, states) Bootstrap supplies for a single navbar item.

concepts.heading: Bootstrap Icons and SVGs
points: Bootstrap Icons (the Icons page) are free to use in any project. Search with the filter, e.g. box-seam for the moving-box logo.

Two ways to use an icon: paste the inline <svg> markup, or download the .svg file into the project and reference it with an img tag (src, alt, height). The lecture chooses the img route for a cleaner page.
Icons used: box-seam (brand), briefcase, bus-front, chat-square-heart (feature icons), chevron-right (link arrow).

concepts.heading: Hero section copied from Examples
points: Examples > Heroes has a centred hero: heading, paragraph, two buttons and an image. Technique: right-click, Inspect, hover up the element tree until the whole section is highlighted, Copy element, then paste below the navbar.
Replace the image src with the moving van, paste the h1 'Move With Joy', the paragraph and button labels (Get a Quote, Contact Us) from the provided website-text file.

Useful classes in it: display-4 fw-bold (big bold heading), lead (larger intro paragraph), col-lg-6 mx-auto (centred half-width column), d-grid gap-2 d-sm-flex justify-content-sm-center (buttons stacked on phones, inline from sm), img-fluid rounded-3 shadow-lg border.

concepts.heading: Features section and custom CSS
points: Same copy-element technique from Examples > Features (three columns with icon squares). Replace the headings and text with Professional, Countrywide and Personal Touch.
Pasted result looks unstyled in the icon squares because Examples pages add their own CSS on top of Bootstrap. Class names like feature-icon do not exist in Bootstrap itself.

How to spot custom CSS: default classes live in Bootstrap's stylesheet, while page-specific ones appear in a separate custom file. Copy the .feature-icon rules (width and height 4rem, border-radius 0.75rem) into the page's style block.
Swap the example SVGs for your downloaded icon images and give each a height of 30. Do the same for the chevron-right in each 'Get a quote' icon-link.
The layout classes row, row-cols-1 row-cols-lg-3 and g-4 produce one column on mobile and three on large screens.

concepts.heading: Carousel (exercise) and container
points: Carousel = slideshow component. Use the basic 'With indicators' example from Components > Carousel; it gives dots at the bottom plus previous and next arrows.
Pasted images are broken because the example img tags have no usable src. Set them to couple, dog and family images.

Structure: .carousel > .carousel-indicators (buttons with data-bs-slide-to index), .carousel-inner > .carousel-item (exactly one has active), and prev/next controls using data-bs-slide. The id on the carousel must match every data-bs-target.
Because the carousel spans the viewport width it is huge. Wrap it in a div.container to line it up with other content and get responsive widths.

concepts.heading: Footer
points: Taken from Snippets > Footers: inspect, copy the footer element and place it last in the body. Only light editing is needed.

concepts.heading: Spacing utilities
points: Pattern: property + side + dash + size. Property m = margin, p = padding.
Sides: t top, b bottom, s start (left), e end (right), x left and right, y top and bottom, none = all sides. Sizes 0 to 5 (0 removes spacing, 5 is the largest standard step).
Examples: mt-5 margin-top size 5; my-3 vertical margin size 3; mb-2 margin-bottom size 2 (seen in the footer markup).
(Extra) Beware that the lecture describes x and y with the axes swapped in speech; in Bootstrap x is horizontal (left and right) and y is vertical (top and bottom).

concepts.heading: Dark mode
points: Add data-bs-theme="dark" on the html element (after lang) and the whole page switches to the dark colour scheme.
Docs location: Customize > Color modes. With JavaScript later, the attribute can be toggled to let users choose.
(Extra) The attribute can also be set on a single element to theme only that region.

concepts.heading: Themes and templates
points: Hosted builders charge a monthly fee; Bootstrap themes are typically a one-off purchase or free.

Sources mentioned: W3Schools Bootstrap templates (basic blog, portfolio, social layouts to customise), the official Themes page on getbootstrap.com (professional, paid), and web searches for free Bootstrap templates.
Approach is the same as in the lesson: pick a template, grab the parts needed, customise with some own CSS. Designers can also build and sell themes.

task.name: 11.2 Bootstrap Components: Move It website
task.starting_point: Starter folder with index.html (Bootstrap CSS link already added, empty style block), website-text file, SVG icons (box-seam, briefcase, bus-front, chat-square-heart, chevron-right) and images (moving-van, couple, dog, family).
task.goal: Two small challenges inside a guided build: (1) add a green Ok button using the Buttons docs; (2) add a carousel section with three images, aligned with the page content. The guided build is a one-page Move It site: navbar, hero, features, carousel, footer.
steps: Download and open the 11.2 starter files in VS Code and preview them.
Challenge 1: find Buttons in the docs and add a button saying Ok with btn and btn-success.
Paste the navbar example into body, then add the Bootstrap JS bundle script before </body> so the toggler and dropdown work.
Edit the navbar: remove the disabled item, rename links to About and Services, set brand to Move It with the box-seam image (height 30), set placeholder Postcode and button text Check.
Copy the hero element from Examples, set the image to the moving van, paste texts from website-text.
Copy the Features example, fill in texts, add the .feature-icon CSS to the style block, replace the SVGs with the downloaded icons with height 30.
Challenge 2: from Components > Carousel copy the indicators example, set the three img src values (couple, dog, family) and wrap the carousel in div.container.
Add a footer from Snippets > Footers. Optionally try data-bs-theme="dark" on html.
task.expected_result: A responsive one-page site with collapsing navbar, centred hero, three feature columns with icons, a working three-slide carousel inside a container, and a footer.

solution_code.code:
<!-- See code_examples: navbar, hero, features, carousel; footer copied from Snippets > Footers -->
<button class="btn btn-success">Ok</button>

pitfalls: Navbar toggler and dropdowns do nothing unless the bootstrap.bundle.min.js script is included.
Copied Examples may rely on page-specific CSS (feature-icon) that has to be copied too.
Broken carousel images: the example has no real src values.
Carousel without a container fills the full width and becomes very tall.
Carousel indicator and control data-bs-target values must match the carousel's id.
Reference repo diverges: uses Bootstrap 5.3.0-alpha CDN, keeps leftover placeholder text such as Action items, a stray svg use tag in the footer and a personal author footer line (ignore it).

playground.coverage: Covers buttons, card, navbar basics and a component catalogue demo (buttons, alerts, badges, list group, form controls). Notes mention the JS bundle and utility class families.
gaps_and_ideas: Add a task to paste the Bootstrap JS bundle and watch the navbar toggler and dropdown start working (the current navbar task uses navbar-nav without a toggler).
Add a carousel task (indicators, carousel-item active, matching data-bs-target ids) and a container-wrapping step.
Add spacing utility decoder table (m/p, t b s e x y, 0-5) with a live demo.
Add a dark mode toggle demo using data-bs-theme on html.
Add a 'copy from Examples' task: hero or features section with custom .feature-icon CSS, teaching the difference between Bootstrap classes and page-specific CSS.
Add Bootstrap Icons as img-referenced SVGs.
Playground solution uses Bootstrap 5.3.3 and currently has no script tag; mention version differences from the course.
